other_conditions: must be a resident of the Union territory of Andaman & Nicobar Islands
must be engaged in building or other construction work
must be registered under the A&N Islands Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
must have an active membership of the Board
hospitalization due to an accident or illness of the beneficiary or their dependent is required to avail assistance
must produce a referral letter from the competent authority
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹5,000 per hospitalization (₹200 per day for the first 5 days, ₹100 thereafter) and additional allowances up to ₹1,00,000 for referred cases, plus emergency and referral benefits.
documents_required: referral letter from the competent authority
